research_question: Does a fixed depth-gradient and pose-diversity hybrid acquisition policy improve reconstruction at a 50-frame budget across independent splits, and does any benefit survive a leakage-resistant trajectory-block holdout?

decision_rules.interleaved_support: Active minus random has positive mean PSNR and negative mean raw AbsRel across the three locked splits, with both directions reproduced on at least two of three splits.
decision_rules.blocked_support: On the blocked holdout, active minus random has positive PSNR and negative raw AbsRel. This run is reported separately and is not pooled with interleaved splits.
decision_rules.robust_support: Both interleaved_support and blocked_support pass without a material LPIPS regression greater than 0.01.
decision_rules.failure: Any failed gate is reported as mixed or negative; no score signal or weight is changed after inspecting results.

analysis.pairing: All active and random comparisons are within the same split and training seed.
analysis.interleaved_summary: Report per-seed deltas, arithmetic means, population standard deviations, sign counts, and a descriptive paired bootstrap interval. With n=3, intervals are not treated as definitive inference.
analysis.blocked_summary: Report the single blocked pair with frame-level dispersion and explicit holdout spans/exclusion frames.
analysis.negative_results: Report every prespecified metric and all completed runs, including alignment failures and selector regressions.

stopping_rule: Stop this experiment family after the two pending interleaved pairs and one blocked pair are evaluated and recorded. Continue to a new dataset only if the robust_support gate passes; otherwise diagnose the failed gate before spending more compute.
